title: cliff-cp: coverage failure of conformal prediction on activity cliffs (software and per-molecule records)
description:
Analysis pipeline, fixed data splits, and per-molecule prediction records (70,170 test-molecule rows) accompanying the manuscript "How the coverage guarantee of conformal prediction fails on activity cliffs: mechanism, diagnosis, and a structural blind spot of applicability domains".

Over 15 ChEMBL single-target datasets from the MoleculeACE benchmark, the repository reproduces: the cliff-versus-non-cliff coverage gap (18.2 percentage points at a nominal 90% coverage), an exact distribution-free coverage-transfer identity and the label-free diagnostic net_mag derived from it, the misalignment criterion that predicts which partition signals harm the cliff group, a decision-impact analysis quantifying how many true actives are discarded, and the structural blindness of applicability-domain filters to this failure mode.

All random seeds are fixed; every figure and table is regenerated by a documented command.
